notes:
Bruno import review and unsaved-work improvements.

- Show Merge/Replace destination errors directly on the Environment selector and focus the field that needs attention.
- Restore a missing import-processing cache from the retained source once, and prevent cancelled or superseded reviews from restoring an old source.
- Remove Last import from sidebar menus while keeping the immediate result, setup review and Undo.
- Offer Cancel or Continue when closing, quitting or updating with unsaved work. Continue does not require Save or successful draft recovery; active and uncertain file/credential writes remain protected.
- Keep the confirmation visible above the update screen and avoid asking again at Restart when the accepted work has not changed.

To test auto update, start from 0.1.5 and update to 0.1.6. The pre-install stage still uses 0.1.5 behavior; the new unsaved-work warning starts once 0.1.6 is running. An older 0.1.3/0.1.4 client blocked by its recovery error needs a manual installation once, after saving unfinished work. Do not clear application storage.

This remains an optional beta update; minimum supported version stays 0.1.1. Windows x64 and macOS Apple Silicon packages use the same source commit and existing Rove updater key. macOS platform signing is ad-hoc, without Apple notarization; this beta has no Windows certificate signing. Source, browser and build checks do not establish installed-app update/restart/data-migration acceptance.
